name: codex-run-budget
description: Shared token governance, native account quota sensing, and recent-task telemetry for Codex.

Cross-task model/Fast/reasoning observations and dated token-credit scenarios stay separate from backend estimates and actual charges, without inventing per-model quota allocations or changing budgets.
